expressions.cn: 你能帮我吗？ (Nǐ néng bāng wǒ ma?)
我明白了。 / 知道了。 (Wǒ míngbái le. / Zhīdào le.)

expressions.en: Can you repeat that? / What did you say?
expressions.cn: 你能再说一遍吗？ / 你说什么？ (Nǐ néng zàishuō yībiàn ma? / Nǐ shuō shénme?)
expressions.bm_formal: Boleh anda ulangi? / Apa yang anda katakan?
expressions.bm_casual: Boleh ulang balik? / Apa dia cakap?

work.scenario: During a virtual team meeting, your colleague's audio cuts out, and you didn't catch their last point. You need to ask them to repeat it. Later, you realize you haven't completed a report on time and need to apologize to your manager.

life.scenario: You're at a bustling hawker centre, trying to order your favourite Char Kuey Teow. The vendor mumbles something about additional toppings, and you didn't quite catch it. You then need to ask for help carrying your heavy tray to your table.

tech.scenario: Your phone battery is critically low, and you're visiting a friend's house. You need to ask if you can use their phone charger. After they kindly lend it to you, you express your gratitude.
